body.condition: Under \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}\), conditional on \(X\), the residualized vector \((D^\top,U^\top)^\top\) has a jointly Gaussian distribution that does not depend on \(X\), has a positive-definite covariance matrix, satisfies \(\operatorname{Var}(D_i)=1\), and satisfies \(\operatorname{Cov}(D_i,U_i)=0\) for every \(i\in V\); cross-setting covariances are unrestricted subject to positive definiteness.
